name: dwc-data-package
title: Darwin Core Data Package
description: A data package containing Darwin Core related tables for molecular data.

schema.name: event
schema.title: Event
schema.description: An action, process, or set of circumstances occurring at a dcterms:Location during a period of time.
schema.examples: `a material collecting event`; `a bird observation`; `a camera trap image capture`; `an organism occurrence`; `a biotic survey`

fields.name: event_pk
fields.title: Event (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for a dwc:Event.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.

fields.name: decimalLongitude
fields.title: Decimal Longitude
fields.description: A geographic longitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of a dcterms:Location.
fields.notes: Positive values are east of the Greenwich Meridian, negative values are west of it. Valid values lie between -180 and 180, inclusive.

fields.name: decimalLatitude
fields.title: Decimal Latitude
fields.description: A geographic latitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of a dcterms:Location.
fields.notes: Positive values are north of the Equator, negative values are south of it. Valid values lie between -90 and 90, inclusive.

fields.name: verbatimLongitude
fields.title: Verbatim Longitude
fields.description: A verbatim original longitude of a dcterms:Location.
fields.notes: The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: verbatimLatitude
fields.title: Verbatim Latitude
fields.description: A verbatim original latitude of a dcterms:Location.
fields.notes: The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: verbatimCoordinateSystem
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinate System
fields.description: A coordinate format for dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude or dwc:verbatimCoordinates.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

fields.name: verbatimSRS
fields.title: Verbatim SRS
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which coordinates given in dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude, or dwc:verbatimCoordinates are based.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use the EPSG code of the SRS, if known. Otherwise use a controlled vocabulary for the name or code of the geodetic datum, if known. Otherwise use a controlled vocabulary for the name or code of the ellipsoid, if known. If none of these is known, use the value `not recorded`. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

fields.name: eventDate
fields.title: Event Date
fields.description: A date-time or time interval during which a dwc:Event occurred.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a date that conforms to ISO 8601-1:2019. Not suitable for a time in a geological context.
fields.examples: `1963-03-08T14:07-06:00` (8 Mar 1963 at or after 2:07pm and before 2:08pm in the time zone six hours earlier than UTC); `2009-02-20T08:40Z` (20 February 2009 at or after 8:40am and before 8:41 UTC); `2018-08-29T15:19` (29 August 2018 at or after 3:19pm and before 3:20pm local time); `1809-02-12` (within the day 12 February 1809); `1906-06` (in the month of June 1906); `1971` (in the year 1971); `2007-03-01T13:00:00Z/2008-05-11T15:30:00Z` (some time within the interval beginning 1 March 2007 at 1pm UTC and before 11 May 2008 at 3:30pm UTC); `1900/1909` (some time within the interval between the beginning of the year 1900 and before the year 1909); `2007-11-13/15` (some time in the interval between the beginning of 13 November 2007 and before 15 November 2007)

fields.name: eventDurationValue
fields.title: Event Duration Value
fields.description: The numeric value for the duration of a dwc:Event.
fields.notes: `An eco:eventDurationValue must have a corresponding eco:eventDurationUnit.`

fields.name: verbatimEventDate
fields.title: Verbatim Event Date
fields.description: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for a dwc:Event.

fields.name: minimumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The least depth within a range of depths, measured relative to the vertical reference surface indicated by the value of dwc:verticalDatum.
fields.notes: See https://docs.gbif.org/georeferencing-best-practices/1.0/en/#img-depth-elevation-distance-above-surface.

fields.name: maximumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The greatest depth within a range of depths, measured relative to the vertical reference surface indicated by the value of dwc:verticalDatum.
fields.notes: See https://docs.gbif.org/georeferencing-best-practices/1.0/en/#img-depth-elevation-distance-above-surface.

schema.name: identification
schema.title: Identification
schema.description: A classification of a resource according to a classification scheme.
schema.notes: For biology, the assignment of a scientific name or taxon concept to a dwc:Organism.
schema.examples: `a subspecies determination of an organism`; `a nomenclatural act designating a specimen as a holotype`

fields.name: identification_pk
fields.title: Identification (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for a dwc:Identification.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.

fields.name: nucleotideSequence_fk
fields.title: Nucleotide Sequence (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:NucleotideSequence based on which a dwc:Identification was made.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: kingdom
fields.title: Kingdom
fields.description: The full scientific name of the kingdom in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: phylum
fields.title: Phylum
fields.description: The full scientific name of the phylum or division in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: class
fields.title: Class
fields.description: The full scientific name of the class in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: order
fields.title: Order
fields.description: The full scientific name of the order in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: family
fields.title: Family
fields.description: The full scientific name of the family in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: genus
fields.title: Genus
fields.description: The full scientific name of the genus in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: specificEpithet
fields.title: Specific Epithet
fields.description: The name of the first or species epithet of the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: scientificName
fields.title: Scientific Name
fields.description: A scientific name string, not including authorship, date or identification qualifiers.
fields.notes: When applied to an Organism or Occurrence, this term should be used to represent the scientific name that was applied to the associated Organism in accordance with the Taxon to which it was or is currently identified. Names should be compliant to the most recent nomenclatural code. For example, names of hybrids for algae, fungi and plants should follow the rules of the International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants (Shenzhen Code Articles H.1, H.2 and H.3). Thus, use the multiplication sign `×` (Unicode `U+00D7`, HTML `×`) to identify a hybrid, not `x` or `X`, if possible.
fields.examples: `Coleoptera` (order); `Vespertilionidae` (family); `Manis` (genus); `Ctenomys sociabilis` (genus + specificEpithet); `Ambystoma tigrinum diaboli` (genus + specificEpithet + infraspecificEpithet); `Quercus agrifolia var. oxyadenia` (genus + specificEpithet + taxonRank + infraspecificEpithet); `×Agropogon littoralis`; `Mentha ×smithiana`; `Agrostis stolonifera L. × Polypogon monspeliensis`

fields.name: scientificNameAuthorship
fields.title: Scientific Name Authorship
fields.description: The authorship information for the dwc:scientificName formatted according to the conventions of the applicable dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

fields.name: taxonRank
fields.title: Taxon Rank
fields.description: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. The taxon ranks of algae, fungi and plants are defined in the International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants (Shenzhen Code Articles H3.2, H4.4 and H.3.1).

fields.name: taxonID
fields.title: Taxon ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: verbatimIdentification
fields.title: Verbatim Identification
fields.description: A string representing the classification as it appeared in the original record.
fields.notes: This term is meant to allow the capture of an unaltered original identification/determination, including identification qualifiers, hybrid formulas, uncertainties, etc. This term is meant to be used in addition to dwc:geologicalMaterialName or dwc:scientificName (and dwc:identificationQualifier etc.), not instead of it.
fields.examples: `Peromyscus sp.`; `Ministrymon sp. nov. 1`; `Anser anser × Branta canadensis`; `Pachyporidae?`; `Potentilla × pantotricha Soják`; `Aconitum pilipes × A. variegatum`; `Lepomis auritus x cyanellus`

fields.name: identificationRemarks
fields.title: Identification Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:Identification.
fields.examples: `Distinguished between Anthus correndera and Anthus hellmayri based on the comparative lengths of the uñas.`

schema.name: molecular-protocol
schema.title: Molecular Protocol
schema.description: A protocol used to perform a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis and potentially derive a dwc:NucleotideSequence from a dwc:MaterialEntity.
schema.examples: `a standard DNA barcoding workflow using Sanger sequencing`; `a shotgun metagenomics pipeline for microbial community profiling`; `a high-throughput amplicon sequencing protocol targeting 16S rRNA`

fields.name: molecularProtocol_pk
fields.title: Molecular Protocol (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for a dwc:MolecularProtocol.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.

fields.name: project_name
fields.title: project_name
fields.description: Name of the project within which the sequencing was organized.

fields.name: associated_resource
fields.title: associated_resource
fields.description: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise associated to the sequence.

fields.name: target_gene
fields.title: target_gene
fields.description: Targeted gene or locus name for marker gene studies.

fields.name: ampliconSize
fields.title: ampliconSize
fields.description: The length of the amplicon in basepairs.

fields.name: pcr_primer_forward
fields.title: pcr_primer_forward
fields.description: Forward PCR primer that were used to amplify the sequence of the targeted gene, locus or subfragment. If multiple multiple forward or reverse primers are present in a single PCR reaction, there should be a full row for each of these linked to the same dwc:Occurrence. The primer sequence should be reported in uppercase letters.

fields.name: pcr_primer_reverse
fields.title: pcr_primer_reverse
fields.description: Reverse PCR primer that were used to amplify the sequence of the targeted gene, locus or subfragment. If multiple multiple forward or reverse primers are present in a single PCR reaction, there should be a full row for each of these linked to the same dwc:Occurrence. The primer sequence should be reported in uppercase letters.

fields.name: annealingTemp
fields.title: annealingTemp
fields.description: The reaction temperature during the annealing phase of PCR.

fields.name: lib_layout
fields.title: lib_layout
fields.description: Specify whether to expect single, paired, or other configuration of reads.

fields.name: otu_db
fields.title: otu_db
fields.description: Reference database (i.e. sequences not generated as part of the current study) used to cluster new genomes in "species-level" OTUs, if any.

fields.name: otu_seq_comp_appr
fields.title: otu_seq_comp_appr
fields.description: Tool and thresholds used to compare sequences when computing "species-level" OTUs.

schema.name: nucleotide-analysis
schema.title: Nucleotide Analysis
schema.description: A link between a dwc:NucleotideSequence and a dwc:Event and a dwc:MaterialEntity from which it was derived, using a specified dwc:Protocol.

fields.name: nucleotideAnalysis_pk
fields.title: Nucleotide Analysis (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.

fields.name: event_fk
fields.title: Event (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Event.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: molecularProtocol_fk
fields.title: Molecular Protocol (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:MolecularProtocol.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: nucleotideSequence_fk
fields.title: Nucleotide Sequence (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:NucleotideSequence.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: readCount
fields.title: Read Count
fields.description: The number of reads obtained for a processed dwc:NucleotideSequence during a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis.

fields.name: processedTotalReadCount
fields.title: Processed Total Read Count
fields.description: The total number of reads obtained for a processed dwc:NucleotideSequence during a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis.

schema.name: nucleotide-sequence
schema.title: Nucleotide Sequence
schema.description: A digital representation of a nucleotide sequence.

fields.name: nucleotideSequence_pk
fields.title: Nucleotide Sequence (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for a dwc:NucleotideSequence.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.

fields.name: sequence
fields.title: Sequence
fields.description: A string representing nucleotide base pairs.
